title: SerializedAssetRef
description: Serialized reference to a loaded asset (e.g. a Texture). Names the request the asset was loaded with, never the asset data: the logical source the caller wrote - the one an asset variant rule was declared for, not the file one device happened to select - and, when they change which resource the request produces, the identity-relevant options. The contract is that referenced assets are pre-loaded into the target Loader before Scene.deserialize runs; the reference then resolves to whatever that loader holds for the same request, including its own variant choice. A reference that needs no options is written as the bare source string, which is also the only form version 1 documents contain.
